status: The layout spec for one mibi up close, the Vivarium's closest level, on the LVGL face: rest and meet in slot V (the Vivarium, whole and up close) and out, compact, offline and painted in slot 10 (the Vivarium's remaining states) of lvgl-switch.md §3. Every drawn region names its word or composition, the states rest, meet and out, the namer as an overlay, the focus as data in place of nav.mjs habitatMove, the events, the bottom line, the strings and the masters. The screen id stays `habitat` until its build renames it
note: The one home of the numbers of one mibi up close, transcribed from station-layouts.md (The Vivarium: the whole and one mibi up close) and its wireframes 19-vivarium-mibi.svg to 19e-vivarium-mibi-wild.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. One mibi up close: the mibi in the living window at the left with its name on a tag under it, its card at the top right, four modules under the card, the strip of bays along the foot. Its parent is the Vivarium's whole (vivarium.json); ← goes there.
purpose: Be with one mibi and choose its next step: greet it, name it, read who it is (its species and stage, where it came from, what it remembers, its code, the heart when it is bonded, its skill notches, its chapters and its stamp), read a bred child's chapter still unread (at home or out with the Companion), take it along or bring it home, have it sit for its portrait, cross it, or return it to the wild. Reads first: the mibi; then its name, then the card

notes.name tag: the mibi's name sits on a tag under it inside the living window, as on Home, so it does not float and the chrome carries system information only; the card does not repeat it. 20 px medium; the box holds ten of the widest letter (200 px, NAME_MAX 10), so the tag is at most 224 wide and a name is never clipped
notes.meet box: the resident's box is 304×312, the box the juvenile stood in on the Incubator's hatch (incubator.json regions.juvenile), so the new mibi reads as the same creature across the hand-off's dither
notes.card: the instrument's readout of this one mibi: who it is (species and stage, where it came from, what it remembers), its code, its stamp and its chapters. The species word is the door to the species' guide
notes.modules: Home's `module` build with its lamp null: one engraved word and its object. All four show on every mibi; the Portrait module is always there and opens the sitting, its own screen under one mibi up close (sitting.json). Companion (wide, the carried set) and Portrait on the first row, Cross (wide, it opens a screen) and Wild on the second; Wild, the act that lets a mibi go, sits last, at the bottom right. The bond is not a module: it is made on the Companion, and the heart on the card is its state (regions.card.heart)
notes.strip: one tile a bay, at most twelve (one vivarium holds at most twelve mibis): the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays. Each tile shows the mibi's thumbnail only; focusing a tile shows that mibi in the window with its name on its tag, and the action names it
notes.namer: the namer (namer.json) is an overlay on one mibi up close, not a screen of its own, over its right column, its panel at 592, 48, 416, 424; the living window stays left of x 592 and in view, and the strip stays visible under it
notes.painting: a mibi whose painting has not landed shows its placeholder with the waiting lamp; the words are on the bottom line only. A painting that lands while the mibi is on screen waits for the next fresh draw (this level opened again, the strip bringing the mibi back, a wake): never a swap in view
notes.amber: nothing on one mibi up close is amber: no module, tile, count, heart or notch is a need. The notice is the frame's (what needs the player anywhere)
notes.out: a mibi out with the Companion is still up close: its place in the window is empty but for the out mark, its name, card, chapters and modules as at home; its chapters can be read while it is out (research is knowledge kept at the Station). Greet needs the mibi here, so it has no greet
notes.notches: the skill notches are the mibi's skill as filled notches only, one to three, on the card; none drawn at zero; never an empty notch, never a figure; they show here and nowhere else on the Station (not in the Library or the Book)
notes.cut: UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29: a cutting press also acts. An event with `cut: true` (the moment) ends on the first key after its hold: the event jumps to its end on that frame and the key then does what it does, as on any other frame (✓ its action, ← back, the pad moves the ring, a coloured key its section). One press is never spent on skipping; the hold already keeps a reflexive double press from acting
notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. The moment (and its placeholder hops), read, release, back and swap are cuts; the meet lands at once; the namer's flash is a cut
notes.carriedDocked: a carried mibi while the Companion is docked is in state rest: greet, Cross, Portrait, Bring home and its plates as for any mibi at home; Wild is refused (strings.wildBlocks.withYou) and the watch never runs on it
notes.take: ✓ on the Companion module queues the request (carryAdd or carryHome): the door shows the mibi in its place with the pending lamp, and the strip's marks change on the frame of the press; no event plays

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc

watch.note: a host rule, not an event (architect, 2026-10-10 02:23): it plays the existing message plate (strings.watchPlate) and the counter's tick, nothing of its own
watch.do: only on one mibi up close: the shown mibi at rest or in the meet that is not in carriedIds (never while carried, docked or away), its time summed over the day while this level shows and the face is awake; at 60 s, once a mibi a day: the first of its habits not yet seen is recorded and the message plate strings.watchPlate shows, with the Data trickle (+1) and the counter's tick while under the day's cap (settings.trickleCap); at the cap the habit is still recorded and the plate shows, with no tick. Nothing amber

rules.listPitch: the plates and the strip's tiles are lists by pitch: { first, pitch, grid }. The strip's `forms` are { name: { upTo, first, pitch, grid } }: n tiles take the form with the smallest upTo at least n. Refused at load: a form with no upTo, two forms with one upTo, a grid shorter than its upTo; refused in props: n > 12 (the bay count is 0 to 12)

initial: by the way in: arriving from the Incubator's hatch (or Home's ✓ Meet), meet; the shown mibi out with the Companion (in carriedIds while the Companion is away), out; else rest. One mibi up close always shows one mibi: with none housed the Vivarium's whole shows its empty state
stateRule: rest: one housed mibi at home shown. meet: the same layout on the first look at a new mibi (never out: a new mibi is at home), from the hatch's hand-off until the first press; the meet ribbon stands in the name tag's place, and the first ✓ opens the namer. out: the shown mibi is out with the Companion: the window shows its place empty with the out mark (regions.resident.out), the tag, the card and the modules as in rest; no greet. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; the arm of Wild is focus.armed, not a state; the namer is an overlay (overlays.namer), not a state; docked and away are conditions of every state (the Companion module, the tiles, the top bar). A carried mibi while the Companion is docked is at home, asleep on the bed: state rest, with greet, Cross, Portrait, Bring home and its plates; Wild refuses it ("already with you") and it is never watched

heart.look: a small enamel heart painted in the house light; never a flat emoji heart, no face, no sparkle

notches.until: a labelled placeholder: a 16×24 `bone` bar with a `hairline` edge
notches.note: sprites the card holds, as the heart; not a focus target

code.room: 152: the widest code, "WWW WWW WWW", is 152 at 16 px; the notches sit 8 px after it

stamp.live: the mibi's stamp, its read chapters filled

states.unread: the unread ground (its dotted edge painted in) and emblem: a bred child's chapter, still a surprise; readable at home or while the mibi is out with the Companion

plates.note: one plate a chapter, in ring order, left-aligned from x 608: the signed ground, then the emblem 24×24 at (8, 8); no word and no pips: the focused plate's chapter is the bottom line's context

places.docked: each mibi's painting or placeholder at 48
places.away: the same: the carried mibis drawn at 48, so the set reads while they are out; the outline glyph says they are out

states.away: the outline glyph and the three places

faces.away: a partner out with the Companion while the Companion is away cannot be picked: its face drawn dimmed, on a `stone` ring (the frame's dimmed role, as the top bar's away faces); the others on the `bevel` ring

states.adult: an adult or an elder with a partner it can pick: one face a partner
states.away: an adult or an elder at home whose partners are all out with the Companion, away: their faces dimmed
states.out: the shown mibi is out with the Companion, away: its faces drawn as for an adult; it cannot cross until it docks
states.alone: an adult or elder with no partner: no faces

states.armed: after the first ✓: the gate ajar

tile.fill: a panel rect in the tile's box
tile.free: a composed `dash` outline round the tile's box, 1 px `hairline`, dash [2, 2]; nothing in it, not a target
tile.away: each mibi with you (up to three) while the Companion is away: the outline Companion glyph 16×24 in place of its thumbnail, centred where the thumbnail stands; it stays a target, and focusing it shows that mibi in state out

tiles.count: one tile a bay (state.bayCount, 0 to 12): the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays

states.shown: the mibi up close: fill `hairline`, one step up (with its outline glyph when it is out)
states.away: the outline glyph, one tile for each mibi with you

moment.do: Greet: the mibi's species moment, from its moving set when it has one; until then the placeholder hops twice (placeholder). Rewards nothing and shows nothing like a reward. Input is held 300 ms; the first key after the hold cuts the moment to its end, and that key then does what it does (notes.cut)

placeholder.rule: UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29: until the moving set lands, two hops, at 0 and 900 ms of the moment, each 400 ms; `lift` is [ms into the hop, px above where the creature stands], each a cut, whole pixels, no ease: up 1 px every 50 ms to 4 at 150, down 1 px every 50 ms to 0 at 350; still from 1250 to 1800. The box, the tag and the ring do not move; the ring stays on the resident's feet

swap.do: the ring moved to another tile: the resident cross-dithers to the tile's mibi (lvgl-switch.md §2.7, the dither event); the tag, the card, the modules and the strip's shown tile are cuts on the frame of the key

meet.when: the Incubator's hatch: its 180 ms dither ends on one mibi up close in state meet (incubator.json handoff)
meet.do: the meet ribbon shows in the tag's place; the new mibi plays its moment once (events.moment with hold 0); the first press removes the ribbon (a cut) and, like any cutting press (notes.cut), also acts: ✓ opens the namer, any other key keeps the default name and does what it does

read.do: a bred child's chapter read: the plate turns from unread to read (a cut) and the stamp prints the chapter's cells row by row from the top over 300 ms, as on Create's grow

release.do: the second ✓ on Wild: the resident dithers out to the next housed mibi in bay order (in state out when that one is out); none left, the frame's screen transition to the Vivarium's whole, empty; its tile becomes a free bay (a cut); the message plate strings.releasePlate

back.do: ←: the frame's screen transition to the Vivarium's whole (vivarium.json), the ring on this mibi's resident, or its tile while it is out

refused.do: the first draw of one mibi up close after a refusal: the message plate strings.carryRefused, once a refusal (state.seenCarryRefusal)

named.do: the namer saved a name: the tag (or the meet ribbon while it shows) takes the frame's flash

entry.homeMeet: resident, the new mibi, in state meet (Home's ✓ Meet)

entry.backFromCross: cross: the target that led there
entry.backFromSitting: portrait: ← from the sitting's pose step (sitting.json keys.back)
entry.sittingBegun: portrait: the sitting's begin lands here, the module in its painting state (sitting.json events.begin)
entry.namerClosed: resident after naming from the meet; name after Rename

selectors.tile.shown: the view resolves it to the shown mibi's tile id; never null while a mibi is shown

focus.rings: each target carries its ring form (frame.json focus.ring.forms): the mibi `feet`, every other target `round`
focus.primitives: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 governs: the edge forms (a name, a selector, nearestIn with ahead, an ordered list), the order of a move and the integer scores on doubled centres; `axis` walks the group's present targets by index and stops at the ends

resident.present: rest and meet; never out (the mibi is not here)

name.box: the tag as drawn, inside regions.nameTag.rect

name.enabled: always: any housed mibi may be renamed, at home, bonded or out with the Companion; never a released one

armed.wild: after the first ✓ on a mibi that may go
armed.clear: any key but ✓ clears the arm; the arm never survives a screen change

focus.held: while events.moment, read, release or back holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends); after the moment's hold, the first key cuts it to its end and then acts (notes.cut); while the namer is open its own graph has every key
